questions.q: Can a Salesforce org have more than one Business Hours record?
options: No, there is exactly one global Business Hours record per org
Yes, an org can have many — typically one per team, region, or time zone
Yes, but only if Multiple Currencies is also activated
No, only Enterprise Edition and above supports Business Hours
questions.explain: The lesson explains that an org can have many Business Hours records, each with its own name, time zone, and weekly schedule.

questions.q: On a Business Hours weekly grid, what does it mean if Sunday's Start Time and End Time are left blank?
options: Sunday defaults to 24 hours
Sunday is treated as fully closed
Sunday inherits Monday's hours
The record cannot be saved until every day has a value
questions.explain: A blank day on the weekly grid means that day is closed, not unset or defaulted to open.

questions.q: What happens if you create a Holiday record but don't associate it with any Business Hours record?
options: It automatically applies to every Business Hours record in the org
It applies only to the org's default Business Hours record
It does nothing — a holiday only has an effect once it's associated with one or more Business Hours records
Salesforce prevents saving a Holiday record with no association
questions.explain: The lesson states plainly that a holiday with no Business Hours associated does nothing; the pairing is what actually suspends the schedule.

questions.q: Which Service Cloud features calculate their due times against a Business Hours record (honoring any attached holidays)?
options: Escalation rules, milestones, and entitlement processes
Page layouts and compact layouts
Record types and business processes
List views and search layouts
questions.explain: The lesson lists escalation rules, milestones, and entitlement processes as the features whose due-time math depends on a Business Hours record plus its attached holidays.

questions.q: A holiday is attached to a Business Hours record set to Eastern Time. What time zone does the holiday itself use?
options: It always uses UTC regardless of the Business Hours record
It automatically takes on the time zone of the Business Hours record it's attached to
It uses the time zone of the admin who created it
Holidays don't have a time zone concept at all
questions.explain: The lesson notes that a holiday automatically acquires the time zone of whichever Business Hours record it's associated with.
